findings.label: Shared default password
findings.detail: All TU accounts are created with the well-known default password 'smkn1kras' and nothing forces a change on first login, so any pegawai account is guessable until an admin manually resets it. Recommend per-account generated passwords or forced change on first login, and at minimum instruct staff to change it immediately.

findings.label: Default password stored in plaintext
findings.detail: The sync writes 'smkn1kras' verbatim into the plain_password column, readable in the admin UI, mirroring the existing teacher/student pattern. Avoid persisting the default in plaintext going forward.

findings.label: Fail-open status mapping
findings.detail: is_active is derived from status_kepegawaian via a denylist of inactive terms, so an unrecognized or empty status yields an active account. Treat unknown/empty status as inactive (fail-closed), or at least log unrecognized values.

findings.label: No automated tests
findings.detail: No tests were added; the role-collision guard, empty-NIP skip, and soft-delete deactivation are covered only by code reading, not by assertions. This matches the task's verification scope (node --check only).
